# Developer-initiated skills: `skills new` mints a creator-only draft on the
# server (template + reserved slug + real id), the workspace tracks it like
# any synced doc, and publish is what reveals it to the review inbox.

fulcrum sync

fulcrum skills new writing-migrations
grep 'draft skill-writing-migrations.md created' last-stdout.txt
grep 'only you see it until you publish' last-stdout.txt
exists skills/skill-writing-migrations.md
grep 'name: writing-migrations' skills/skill-writing-migrations.md

# Tracked immediately: fresh template classifies synced.
fulcrum status
grep 'skill-writing-migrations.md' last-stdout.txt
! grep 'unsynced' last-stdout.txt

# Reserved names are refused with the server's message.
fulcrum -code 2 skills new writing-migrations
grep 'exists' last-stderr.txt

# Edit → drifted → publish sends the content wrap; apply resolves it.
cp edited-draft.md skills/skill-writing-migrations.md
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'drifted' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum publish --yes --note first-version
grep 'Proposal #101 submitted' last-stdout.txt
srv apply 101
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'proposal #101 accepted' last-stdout.txt

-- edited-draft.md --
---
name: writing-migrations
description: How this team writes replay-safe migrations.
---

# writing-migrations

Plain SQL, schema DSL, or migration-local models only.
